cards.subject: hormone pellets

: Pros and Cons
cards.alt: Hormone pellets give steady levels with no shot day, but the dose is fixed until the pellet dissolves

bad.heading: The trade-off
items: No simple way to dial it back
Conservative dosing from labs matters most

cards.subject: hormone injections
cards.heading: Hormone Injections: Pros and Cons
title: Hormone Injections
: Pros and Cons
cards.alt: Hormone injections are inexpensive and easy to fine-tune, but levels wave between doses and some feel the trough

bad.heading: The trade-off
items: Fatigue or irritability at the trough
Splitting doses flattens it, for many

cards.subject: hormone creams
cards.heading: Hormone Creams and Gels: Pros and Cons
title: Hormone Creams
and Gels: Pros and Cons
cards.alt: Hormone creams give the most physiologic rhythm and are easiest to adjust, but absorption varies and residue transfers

bad.heading: The trade-off
items: Missed days show as symptom swings
Residue can transfer by skin contact

Schedule
